title: apps.json — origin catalog contract (D-06)
description: Contract each ORIGIN publishes (D-06): a platform's app catalog. Identical for every origin (official in-repo or unofficial remote creator). tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10) reads origins in this shape and emits the CONSOLIDATED catalog (schema/catalog.schema.json, D-15) with an added creators map + per-app official/creator. See docs/epics DECISIONS D-06/D-14/D-15.

description.description: May contain HTML — treat as untrusted (C-03).

image.description: Icon/preview URL (must be HTTPS on the deployed site, C-02).

devices.description: Hardware variants within the platform, e.g. ST/STE/MegaST/MegaSTE.

binary.description: URL to the current .uf2 firmware (external; must be HTTPS to download, C-02).
